# docsrs-cli
> One-shot stdin/stdout CLI for crates.io and docs.rs documentation for LLM agents.

docsrs-cli is a born-execute-finalize-die binary that searches crates on crates.io, fetches docs.rs README overviews and typed rustdoc items, searches in-crate symbol indexes, and validates local readiness with doctor. Stdout is the data contract. Stderr is diagnostics only. JSON is automatic when stdout is not a TTY. Current release is 1.2.0.

## Release 1.2.0 agent surface (Camada Y)
- Method missing `#method.X` → `ok=false` / `not_found` (exit 66); never parent-page false success
- Successful method fetch sets `data.extraction` to `method` only; agents MUST reject missing/`item_page`
- `--suggest` on method 404 ranks method leaves from the parent type HTML
- Error envelopes include top-level `command` and `duration_ms` (parity with success)
- Budget flags above hard max fail closed with exit 65 (no silent clamp)
- Body over configured `--max-body-bytes` (within hard max) is `error.kind=budget`, exit 74, `retryable=false`
- Method 404 `source_url` keeps the first probe kind (`struct`), not the last
- Dry-run documents `validation=url_shape_only` and parent kind probes
- Offline schemas: 19 wire names matching `schema --cmd all` (includes cache/config aliases)
- Skills EN/PT MUST reject method success when `extraction` is not `method`

## Release surface retained from 1.1.x
- `--match exact|prefix|substring` on search-in-crate (default prefix)
- `--page-token` on search-crates without positional query when the token carries the full query
- `--page-token` success and dry-run echo `query`/`page`/`per_page`/`sort` from the **effective URL**
- `--suggest` ranks exact → prefix → substring → edit-distance
- `doctor` top-level `ok` mirrors `data.ok` (exit 78 when unhealthy)
- Explicit `--timeout 0` / `--connect-timeout 0` fail-closed with exit 65
- `item_path` accepts hyphens and normalizes to underscores (rustc paths)
- Markdown scrub removes rustdoc chrome (`§`, "Copy item path")
- `doctor --online` for DNS probes to crates.io and docs.rs
- `data.cache_hit` on network payloads (local disk cache only)
- Canonical wire field `crate_name`
- `item_name` on get-item; associated methods resolve to `#method.name`
- `resolved_version` for concrete SemVer or stdlib channel `stable`
- Ranked hit `score` on search-in-crate
- Product knobs: CLI flags + XDG config.toml only (no product `DOCSRS_CLI_*` env)
- Completions emit raw shell scripts unless `--json` is explicit
- Human pre-release smoke: `scripts/smoke-live.sh` (not CI)
